Apple Event Highlights Product Chief John Ternus

During Apple's recent product launch event, CEO Tim Cook introduced John Ternus, the company's product chief, to present new iPhones. Cook's gesture, stating "That's your guy," directed attention to Ternus, who then showcased the latest devices. The event was watched live by an estimated 2 million viewers on YouTube, and social media has reportedly praised Apple's presentation approach.
